title: Father and Son Breaking the Game
next_chapter_hook: The last words before Chen Tianming's dissipation will become Chen Ji's ultimate belief in defying heaven's mandate—yet the backlash from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets comes far faster than imagined.

text.content: The moment Chen Tianming's figure struggled out from the core, a dazzling golden light pierced through the air from afar—the Sect-Annihilation Decree Arrow of Tianqing Sect. The golden radiance tore through the night sky like a burning meteor, carrying overwhelming might straight toward Chen Ji. "Ji'er, dodge!" Chen Tianming roared, his shattered spirit一震, blocking in front of Chen Ji with his last strand of strength. The arrow struck his chest, erupting in an earth-shattering roar, countless runes scattering from the collision point, scorching and distorting the air for miles around.

dialogue.content: "Father! Are you alright?" Chen Ji's eyes nearly burst from their sockets as he watched Chen Tianming's spirit be pierced by the arrow, the bowl-sized hole in his chest frantically devouring his remaining essence. Agony, rage, regret—countless emotions churned in his chest, but Chen Ji forcibly suppressed them all. He tightly clenched his fists until his nails dug into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. This arrow was meant to take his life. But he would not cry. Would not panic. He recorded it all. When the time was ripe, he would repay this arrow's debt a hundredfold to those self-righteous hypocrites of Tianqing Sect.

text.content: "It's nothing..." Chen Tianming's voice became ethereal and illusory, as if it would dissipate in the wind at any moment. But his eyes remained clear, filled with a resolute acceptance of death. He slowly raised his hand, his old palm covered with scars pressing against Chen Ji's crown, and a scalding wave of bloodline power instantly surged into Chen Ji's body. "The seal of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... is about to be completed. You must... before that..." His words came intermittently, yet every word branded itself into Chen Ji's heart like a searing iron. The bloodline between father and son produced an unprecedented resonance at this moment—a bond that transcended life and death.

dialogue.content: "A dying struggle." A cold voice came from the depths of the Void, the will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, filled with cold mockery. "Chen Tianming, do you think a mere Sect-Annihilation Decree Arrow can change anything? Fate was long ago determined—Chen Ji is merely a piece on my chessboard." The golden pupil opened in the Void, the pressure crushing down like a mountain, enveloping Chen Ji and his father. "Your resistance... merely writes a more magnificent tragedy."

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, staring directly at that lofty golden pupil. His chest felt as if a ball of fire was burning, searing away all his cowardice and restraint. "A piece?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, yet carried a spine-chilling cold smile. "Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you overestimate yourself." He slowly stood up, his aura suddenly surging, completely different from the abject废物 he had been moments before. "I, Chen Ji, from this day forward, will be no one's piece. If heaven is unrighteous, then I shall overturn this heaven; if fate is unjust, then I shall defy this fate!"

choice.prompt: Facing the pressure of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, Chen Ji made his decision—

choices.description: Fully resonating with father's bloodline, burning all Heavenly Fate Value to exchange for a chance at a sure-kill strike
choices.visible_reward: Unlocking [Father-Son Unity] special state, dealing a devastating blow to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: Zero Heavenly Fate Value will temporarily seal the functions of the Tianji Record
choices.process_label: 陈机毫不犹豫地选择了燃烧

dialogue.content: "Father, lend me all your power!" Chen Ji knelt on one knee, forming seals with both hands, and the bloodline mark left by his father on his crown suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light. In that instant, an unprecedented resonance occurred between Chen Ji and Chen Tianming—the bloodline power felt like two rivers separated for years finally converging into the same sea. Scalding power surged through his meridians, searing his five viscera and six bowels, but he gritted his teeth and uttered not a sound.

text.content: "Good... This is a true son of the Chen family!" A relieved smile appeared on Chen Tianming's aged face. He extended his illusory hand, clasping fingers with Chen Ji, and the two bloodline powers instantly merged into one. In that moment, Chen Ji felt his perception infinitely amplified—he could sense his father's memories, his former humiliations, his unyielding不甘, and... that never-extinguished flame of vengeance. "Remember this secret technique—[Heavenly Fate Rebirth Art]. This is our Chen family's sole means of opposing the Heavenly Dao."

choices.memory_label: 血脉共鸣的灼烧感将永远烙印在陈机的记忆中

choices.description: Activating the Tianji Record Fragment, using foresight to find the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' flaw
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining [Flaw Insight] effect, next attack will be a guaranteed critical hit
choices.risk_hint: Foresight may trigger the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' alertness
choices.process_label: 陈机冷静分析，选择了智取

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not rush to act. He closed his eyes, his mind sinking into the Mental Sea, touching that page of the fragment emanating a faint glow. In an instant, future fragments flashed through his mind like a parade— he saw the weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, the timing when the flaw would appear, the possibility of his victory. "Found it..." His eyes snapped open, his pupils reflecting countless complex runes, a victorious smile tugging at the corner of his lips.

text.content: "In three breaths, a fissure will appear three inches below the right side of its core." Chen Ji firmly engraved the foreseen image into his mind, turning to whisper to Chen Tianming, "Father, I will draw its attention, you strike that location when the moment comes." His father slightly nodded, a flash of approval in his eyes. This child... was more composed and more terrifying than he had imagined. In a desperate situation, yet still able to maintain such clear judgment. This was true Chen family blood.

"[Heavenly Fate Rebirth Art]—" Chen Tianming's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a desolate and ancient resonance. "This technique... was a sliver of opportunity our Chen family ancestors stole from the Heavenly Dao at the cost of their very beings. Using bloodline as the medium, Heavenly Fate as the guide, gathering the power of past, present, and future three time periods into a single point..." Countless complex runes and diagrams flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, the secret teachings accumulated by generations of the Chen family, the ultimate means to oppose the Heavenly Dao. It was as if countless fireworks exploded in his mind, agony and enlightenment arriving simultaneously.

dialogue.content: "Impossible! That is..." For the first time, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice wavered. That lofty golden pupil abruptly contracted, as if witnessing something unimaginable. "The Chen family actually passed down that kind of thing?!" A rare hint of panic colored its tone. "No... this cannot be! This seat clearly erased all traces!" Chen Tianming gave a bitter smile: "Heavenly Dao, you thought you could erase everything? The memory of bloodline, that is a forbidden zone you can never touch."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forming the final magic seal with both hands. In that instant, three different-colored lights bloomed from his body—the past was crimson desolation, the present was golden brilliance, the future was silver-white hope. The three lights intertwined and wove together, gathering into an attack strong enough to tear apart the heavens. "Eye of Heavenly Secrets—" his voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached every being present, "You say I am a piece? Then today, I will show you how a piece drags the chess player down from the divine seat!"

choice.prompt: The Bloodline Secret Technique is about to be completed—Chen Ji must choose how to strike—

choices.text: Full Power Strike · Smash the Core
choices.description: Converge the three strands of bloodline power into a single point, striking directly at the core of the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Inflicts devastating damage upon the Heavenly Eye, its consciousness briefly scattering
choices.risk_hint: May fail to completely shatter it, leaving hidden dangers
choices.process_label: 陈机选择了最直接的碾压方式

text.content: "Go!" Chen Ji thrust both palms forward, the three strands of bloodline power transforming into a roaring dragon of light, opening its gaping maw to crash directly into the core of the Heavenly Eye. A flash of terror flickered through those golden pupils—it wanted to dodge, but discovered its consciousness had been locked in place by some force. It was Chen Tianming! This great father, with his broken body, had seized this precious moment for his son. In a thunderous boom, the core of the Heavenly Eye was pierced, countless golden fragments scattering in all directions, and that lofty, dominating pressure collapsed in an instant.

choices.description: Only strike the portion of the restriction binding Chen Tianming, rescuing his father
choices.visible_reward: Successfully rescue Chen Tianming, but the Heavenly Eye remains intact
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will regain mobility, potentially reversing the situation

dialogue.content: "Father, I've come to save you!" Chen Ji shifted his attack direction, the three strands of bloodline power becoming a massive blade of light that precisely cut into the binding restriction network around Chen Tianming. Clang—a crisp shattering sound rang out, and those golden chains began to crack and collapse. Chen Tianming's figure finally broke free completely, his illusory form swaying unstably, yet bearing a serene smile. "Good child... you did it..."

text.content: But at that very moment, the Heavenly Eye's mocking voice rang out once more: "A foolish choice. Abandoning a prime attack opportunity for a dying man... truly, this bloodline sentimentality makes for entertaining theater. This one enjoys such performances." Though its core remained unharmed, there was now a hint of playful amusement in its tone, as if savoring a performance whose ending had long been predetermined. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly—he filed away this mockery. For now, save his father; one day, he would collect the full debt with interest.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择了救父而非杀敌

text.content: "Enough." Chen Tianming spoke suddenly, his voice weak yet carrying an unmistakable authority. He walked slowly toward Chen Ji, each step seeming to tread upon the river of time, stirring层层涟漪. "Ji'er, everything this father could teach you, I have taught. The road ahead... you must walk it yourself." He reached out, gently stroking Chen Ji's cheek—the touch ethereal yet warm, like a father's embrace from memory. "This father has lived with too many regrets. But watching you grow into who you are now... I can die content."

dialogue.content: "Father! What do you mean, die content!" Chen Ji grabbed his father's hand suddenly, but only grasped void. His eyes reddened, yet his voice maintained that deliberate calm. "I haven't let you enjoy happiness yet, haven't cleared your name yet, haven't—" The words caught in his throat, forced back down. What use are tears? Only the weak weep. His fists clenched until his nails cut into his palms, using pain to anchor himself—remember this moment of helplessness, remember this grief. Let it temper him until he grows strong enough to reshape everything.

text.content: "Silly child..." Chen Tianming watched his son fight back tears, his weathered face displaying a complicated mix of pride and sorrow. He knew what this child had endured—treated as worthless, trampled by others, cast aside by the world. Yet he also knew the fire burning within this child's heart—how unyielding, how steadfast. "Listen carefully, Ji'er. Though formidable, the Heavenly Eye is not invincible. Its power derives from the Heavenly Fate Values of all beings beneath heaven—if you can locate its true form..." His voice grew ever fainter, his form beginning to turn transparent. "This father has already inscribed its location... into your bloodline..."

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming was about to dissipate—Chen Ji needed to make a final vow—

choices.description: Promise his father that he would utterly destroy the Heavenly Eye and seek justice for the Chen clan
choices.visible_reward: Gain the [Vow of Revenge] status, dealing +30% damage to Heavenly-related enemies
choices.risk_hint: The obsession with revenge may affect one's mind
choices.process_label: 陈机做出了最符合本性的选择

dialogue.content: "Father, I make this vow to you—" Chen Ji knelt on both knees and kowtowed three times, his forehead striking the ground in the silent void, the sound echoing endlessly. "The Heavenly Eye, the Tianqing Sect, all who wronged our Chen family... I, Chen Ji, make this solemn vow—we will make them pay in blood for every debt!" His voice cut sharp as steel, his eyes blazing with unbridled hatred and resolve. "Your vengeance, the entire Chen clan's vengeance—I will wash it clean with their blood!"

text.content: "Good... good..." Chen Tianming nodded with a serene smile, his form now nearly invisible. "This is... a true son of the Chen family... Remember... don't let hatred consume you... Become someone... who can master their own destiny..." As the final word fell, his form dissolved completely into scattered starlight, merging into Chen Ji's body. Those motes of light carried his father's final warmth and strength, embedding an indelible mark deep within Chen Ji's heart.

choices.memory_label: 父亲消散时眼中的欣慰成为陈机最珍贵的记忆

choices.description: A vow to his father, not only to seek revenge, but to transcend the Heavenly Way and forge a new era
choices.visible_reward: Obtained the 'Heart of the Transcender' status, all attributes +5%
choices.risk_hint: The goal is overly ambitious, and may suffer greater backlash
choices.process_label: 陈机展现出了超越常人的野心

dialogue.content: "Father, I will not merely seek revenge." Chen Ji rose to his feet, his gaze burning with something fiercer than revenge—the hunger for transcendence. "I want the Eye of Heavenly Way to know that the old order it represents will be utterly destroyed. I will ensure that between heaven and earth, there is no distinction between chess players and chess pieces!" His voice echoed across the desolate battlefield, carrying an air of sovereign supremacy. "Watch and see, Father. One day, I will show you a completely new world."

text.content: Chen Tianming's final glance before dissipation was filled with pride and relief. This child... was more exceptional than he had imagined. No, perhaps 'terrifying' would be a more fitting description. At such a young age, he already displayed such astonishing boldness and ambition. His future achievements would likely far surpass his own. "Good... good..." His final words scattered in the wind, "Your father... believes in you..." Flecks of starlight merged into Chen Ji's body, carrying his father's final blessings and expectations.

choices.memory_label: 父亲临终前的骄傲眼神成为陈机前进的动力

text.content: Chen Ji stood still, allowing his father's starlight to merge into his body. Sorrow, rage, and不甘—these emotions churned like a raging tide within his chest, crashing wildly. But he did not let himself drown in them. Slowly, he raised his head, gazing at the Eye of Heavenly Way still lurking menacingly in the void. "Have you seen enough?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, and even a faint smile curled at the corner of his lips. "My father is gone. But he left me with something—" He raised his hand, pointing at the Eye of Heavenly Way, "—the method to defeat you."

dialogue.content: "Hmph, what use could something left by a dead man possibly serve?" The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice remained filled with arrogance, yet deep within those golden pupils, a trace of unease flickered. Although that previous attack had failed to pierce its core, it had made the entity feel a long-forgotten sense of threat. "Chen Ji, do you think that acquiring a bit of bloodline inheritance allows you to oppose this seat? How naive of you." Its tone carried a chilling killing intent. "However, since you wish to die, this seat will accommodate you. The next time we meet, this seat will personally act and crush your hopes utterly."

text.content: "Is that so?" Chen Ji did not become angry but laughed instead, and that smile under the moonlight appeared particularly chilling. "Then I will be waiting right here." He turned and walked toward the direction he had come from, his figure resolute and lonely. "Eye of Heavenly Way, you had better remember this—the debt of killing my father today, I will repay tenfold in the future. Your so-called destiny chess game, from this day forward, will be played by me." His voice gradually faded into the distance, yet it exploded like thunder in the ears of every existence. "I, Chen Ji, will be no one's chess piece. All things in heaven and earth shall be my chess pieces!"

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to vanish into the night, a faint yet clear voice suddenly rang out in his mind—it was his father's final words, carrying boundless love and expectation: "Ji'er... remember... your destiny... only you can write it..." Chen Ji's footsteps abruptly halted. In that instant, he seemed to feel his father's hand gently stroking the top of his head, just like when he was a child. "I understand, Father." He whispered in response, his voice carrying a rare softness. "I will make it happen."
